title: Deck Atlas
summary: Offline maps on the deck: your MBTiles, PMTiles and tile folders.
description: A map viewer that works offline: import MBTiles or PMTiles files, or a z/x/y tile folder from a tile downloader (converted on the deck), from the SD card or a USB stick; pan and zoom by touch or keys. Optional online sources (OpenTopoMap, Thunderforest and Geoapify with your own key), off until you switch them on, keep the tiles you viewed. Needs a 480x320 screen (320x480 in PDA mode). GPS comes later.
depends: libfreetype6, libinput10, libxkbcommon0, libsqlite3-0, libcurl4t64, ca-certificates
